plugins.name: nav
plugins.description: Keep code healthy: audit, refactor, sync headers and reader documents, plan, do, and compose.

plugins.name: shape
plugins.description: Converge decisions, align priorities, reconcile project records, and hand off sessions.

plugins.name: frame
plugins.description: Apply an explicit, named frame that adds substantive reasoning checks without a fixed output worksheet — to a problem (three reasoning lenses: first-principles, orthogonal, dialectic) or to an answer you already have (analogize — a stress-tested analogy; draw — render it, with the form chosen by the kind of knowledge). Lenses feed shape one-way; analogize does not. Standalone. Renamed from think.

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Coordinate asynchronously through a verified GitHub workspace under the Accord memory model. Route independent follow-ups, expose native lifecycle findings and stage age, hand off the current baton without moving settlement authority, and commit exact settled memory directly. Language-agnostic.
